watchOS 27.2 will be released next month, bringing new features to Apple Watch. Tipster pdfu has also discovered major changes to the screenshot functionality.

New screenshot experience in watchOS 27.2 code borrows from iPhone design

Tipster pdfu has recently begun sharing numerous details discovered from Apple's code. For example, he was the first to find the Readiness app in watchOS 27, and just yesterday also leaked the interface for Siri AI on HomePod.

In a new article today, pdfu revealed that the watchOS 27.2 beta contains code related to a new screenshot experience for Apple Watch.

Currently, when taking a screenshot on Apple Watch, the screen simply flashes, and the screenshot is automatically saved to the Photos library.

The new screenshot flow mimics the current approach on iPhone and iPad, allowing users to choose to immediately share and/or delete the screenshot.

It remains unclear whether Apple plans to include this change in the upcoming watchOS 27.2 beta, or whether more development time is needed. But even if it doesn't make it into watchOS 27.2, this feature is likely to come to Apple Watch in the near future.

What do you think of the new screenshot experience leaked for watchOS 27.2? Let us know in the comments.
